overview.text: Today's key developments span practical model updates, specialized security frameworks, and foundational multimodal research. OpenAI released Images 2.6 to deliver faster generation, GIF creation, precise editing, and new API controls, alongside GPT‑6 Cyber for finding vulnerabilities and developing authorized fixes. In research, NitroFusion2 applies adversarial loss to the text stream of multimodal diffusion transformers via joint attention, while Turns Matter advances streaming video reinforcement learning through turn-level credit assignment. Additionally, Google's TPU infrastructure challenges existing inference moats, and new open-weight releases like ricursiveAI/Ripple-65B-Preview and nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B expand available architecture options for practitioners building production systems.

entries.title: Introducing Images 2.6
entries.summary: Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, GIF creation, more precise editing, and new API controls across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.
entries.why: Offers faster image generation, GIF creation, and precise editing across multiple interfaces.

entries.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
entries.summary: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.
entries.why: Advances aligned cybersecurity agents capable of finding vulnerabilities and developing authorized fixes.

entries.title: AI is forcing us to pay off 40 years of technical debt
entries.why: Highlights the broader industry challenge of paying off decades of accumulated technical debt.

entries.title: NitroFusion2: Bringing Adversarial Loss to the Text Stream of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
entries.summary: Adversarial diffusion distillation has conventionally relied on image features for discrimination. We revisit this choice for multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs), whose text stream becomes image-dependent through joint attention.
entries.why: Brings adversarial loss to the text stream of multimodal diffusion transformers.

entries.title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
entries.summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing.
entries.why: Advances streaming video reinforcement learning via turn-level credit assignment.

entries.title: GaussianRenderFormer: Transformer-based Rendering of 3D Gaussian Splats
entries.summary: Can a neural network learn to render 3D Gaussian splats on its own, with no rasterizer in the renderer? We present GaussianRenderFormer, a transformer that takes a set of Gaussians and a camera and outputs the image directly.
entries.why: Presents a transformer-based renderer for 3D Gaussian splats without a traditional rasterizer.

entries.title: UniRestorer++: Scalable Universal Image Restoration with Multi-Granularity Degradation Modeling
entries.summary: Universal image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a single model, but a reliable scaling strategy remains underexplored.
entries.why: Explores scalable universal image restoration using multi-granularity degradation modeling.

entries.title: ricursiveAI/Ripple-65B-Preview · Hugging Face
entries.why: Provides a new open model preview for local deployment and experimentation.

entries.title: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B
entries.why: Delivers an automatic speech recognition model with strong community download metrics.

entries.title: JosssphZhou/poki
entries.summary: Let AI agents operate a real iPhone. Local MCP server and agent, no jailbreak, no extra hardware. · JavaScript
entries.why: Enables AI agents to operate a real iPhone using a local MCP server.

entries.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
entries.why: Delivers fast and cost-effective performance with support for longer video clips.

entries.title: Detecting signs of hypertension using wearable sensors
entries.why: Explores health and bioscience applications using wearable sensors to detect hypertension.

entries.title: The Iron(wood) Throne: Google's TPU Stakes Its Claim on Inference
entries.summary: Viable Alternative of CUDA Moat, NVIDIA scared and working nights & weekends, Jensen’s Counter Submission, Kimi K3, Muse Spark Open, Qwen, GLM5.3, TorchTPU, vLLM, SGLang, llm-d, Ray
entries.why: Analyzes Google's TPU infrastructure staking its claim on high-performance model inference.

entries.title: AI #193: Progress May Dramatically Accelerate
entries.why: Discusses warnings that artificial intelligence progress may dramatically accelerate soon.

entries.title: Desiderata for the Theory of Agents
entries.summary: TLDR: I give informal conceptual desiderata for the theory of agents we need to solve ASI alignment, and show a few examples of how existing theories fall short of these desiderata. A Theory of What?
entries.why: Outlines informal conceptual desiderata for the theory of agents needed to solve ASI alignment.
